test_results_runtime_verified.summary_shows_SHOULDERS_header_session_t: PASS (screenshot confirms: 'DAY COMPLETE / SHOULDERS', 'Session 3s', '08:10 → 08:10', 5 items each with 08:10 timestamp)

test_results_code_review_verified_not_ru.back_to_week_returns_to_dashboard_mon_Do: Code path correct — addCompletion in storage.js sets progress[pid][weekStart][dayNum]='done' at POINTS_TARGET=5; Dashboard reads from this. Not re-asserted because script exited early after summary auto-redirect.
test_results_code_review_verified_not_ru.day2_workout_stack_excludes_B_circuit_7_: Code path correct — Workout.jsx line 33-36 filters EXERCISES[dayNum].filter(e=>e.type==='A'). exercises.js Day 2 has 7 A + 1 B('Circuit B2 Power & Conditioning'). Type B cannot enter the stack.
test_results_code_review_verified_not_ru.sun_rest_day_no_enter_button_route_opens: Code path correct — DayDetail.jsx wraps enter-workout-button in `{!restDay && ...}` block (line 110). DAY_META[7].rest=true.
test_results_code_review_verified_not_ru.phase1_regression_testids_present: All Phase 1 testids (day-tile-*, week-summary, logout-button, add-profile-button, guest-button) present in source; runtime verified guest-button + dashboard load.

critical_code_review_comments: Workout.jsx Summary navigation works only when component is mounted; if user closes app at exactly 5 completions before the 350ms setTimeout fires, navigation is skipped but day is already marked done (addCompletion persists). Acceptable — user can re-enter via Day Detail which routes to /summary when dayCompleted.

Summary.jsx redirects to /dashboard if workout has 0 completions, but does not enforce that completions.length === POINTS_TARGET. A partially-completed day theoretically renders Summary if accessed directly. Minor (not user-reachable through normal UI).

Workout.jsx onDragEnd uses absolute offset (>110) which can be flaky on small viewports; sr-only complete-top-card fallback is a sensible test affordance. Real swipe gesture verified working in this test.
addCompletion silently no-ops on duplicate exerciseId — good. Persistence test confirmed previously-completed cards do not reappear in the remaining stack after reload.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of runtime-executed assertions; all Phase 2 features functioning

seed_data_creation: None — localStorage/sessionStorage cleared at test start.
